# strfmt/show_char

> show(x) for u8: the byte as a one-character string (`'a'` gives `a`; use `x as int` for its number).

truck [strfmt](../strfmt.md) · [source](../../../registry/strfmt/show_char.pkg)

One of the `show` packages; the type of `x` picks which one applies.
See [strfmt](../strfmt.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `expr`

```
show ( {x: expr u8} ) -> str
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | expression | `u8` |

Produces: `str`

## Needs

- [strfmt/lib](lib.md)

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
sf_char({x})
```

[strfmt/cat](cat.md), [strfmt/fmt](fmt.md)
